The '''Trail's End''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Besia Osurne]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]]. It was favored by [[breedtash]] ranchers and meat packers.
